llmBrief: Keyword "sports betting odds" searched App Store term "sports betting odds" and analyzed 82 reviews from 6 apps (Scores and Odds Sports Betting, Action Network: Sports Betting, BettingPros: Picks & Odds, Outlier: Smart Sports Betting, Live Scores and Odds) over the requested 3 month window. Highest-priority roadmap clusters: pricing / subscription (0 requests, 9 complaints, 0 loves); reliability / bugs (1 requests, 4 complaints, 0 loves); support / customer service (0 requests, 3 complaints, 0 loves); search / filtering (1 requests, 0 complaints, 1 loves); performance / battery (0 requests, 1 complaints, 0 loves); login / account (0 requests, 1 complaints, 0 loves). Use example reviews as evidence, not generic sentiment.
